name: GA Cubers Three Bananas 2025
information: This competition will **not** hold the 3x3x3 speedsolving event. Instead, it will hold some other official events as well as the unofficial events of **Banana Cube**, **FTO**, and **Three-Person TeamBLD**. See the **Unofficial Events** tab for more information. This competition is supported by [Southeast Cubing, Inc.](https://southeastcubing.org/about)! **Please check out the Southeast Cubing tab to learn more about the official nonprofit organization for speedcubing in the Southeast and what you can do to support the mission.** ![](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/rails/active_storage/blobs/redirect/eyJfcmFpbHMiOnsiZGF0YSI6NTEyNzEsInB1ciI6ImJsb2JfaWQifX0=--48835820c0a2f7db4e39fda9f905a4bf335614a0/sexy.png)
